explanation: The bubble fraction is $\frac{p-1}{m+p-1} = \frac{3}{15} = 20\%$: the pipeline takes `p − 1` steps to fill and as many to drain. Doubling the micro-batches to 24 brings it to 11%. The 1F1B schedule has the same bubble but keeps only `p` micro-batches of activations alive instead of `m`, and interleaved schedules (several smaller stages per GPU) shrink the bubble itself, at the cost of more communication.
